scope: Учебный ML-бенчмарк; показатели не являются клинической оценкой.
label_transform: label = int(original_target == 0); D08 retains original mapping and is a separate experiment
fit_rules: Same six features and training rows for LLMs and classical baselines; scaler fit only on each baseline's 5 or 20 rows. No tuning on test. No classical model with zero training samples.
aggregation: Report each shots regime separately. Do not count E01's 300 row requests as 300 ordinary bank tasks or pool them into A-F macro scores.
dataset_contamination: Public dataset may be in LLM training data; record as a limitation. Never send row_id, original index or test label to the model.
